pull_request.title: Tracker: Implement preliminary pixel detector in DD4hep and nodehammer
pull_request.head: detector/preliminary-pixel-detector
pull_request.body:
Implements the human-selected preliminary pixel baseline: the PR34/35 barrel plus proposal B from #36. This PR is stacked on #36 so the implementation can be reviewed separately. DES015 records the selection and implementation boundaries; formal design status stays DRAFT.

The standalone DD4hep compact contains four barrel layers and 18 endcap discs, with reusable module/passive-part/disc factories, local support and Ti/CO2 evaporators, mounting tongues, carrier/rails, and configurable effective cable/service materials. Endcap ASICs face their support; original x/y, module/chip IDs and active shapes are preserved. The barrel-only export remains unchanged. Nodehammer projects cover the full detector, sensitive elements, barrel, stave, positive endcap, one disc and one module.

Validation at code revision `d2a0f3e23449e06b75fb0717263dfbc7010c55a0`:

- 5,066 modules / 14,858 sensitive chip patches; all transforms, packed IDs and 74,290 pixel-cell centres match.
- Zero ROOT overlaps at 1e-5 mm; exclusive material inventories match; 93 navigation rays exercise all 22 planes. All 6 CTests pass.
- Nodehammer import/NHB round trip, all 7 project mesh inventories and GLB units pass; 8 display safeguards pass. Verified float32 translation rescaling is repaired without relaxing the audit tolerance.
- One-shot build/display/Geant4-initialization workflow passes. Geant4 11.4.2 converts the geometry and registers 14,858 sensitive paths; **zero events transported**.
- Six export artifacts are byte-identical under the same Python. Dashboard 27 tests, dashboard build/validation and 73 session records pass.

Review boundaries: internal inserts/saddles, radial pipe transitions, local flex and coupling hardware are inventory-normalized approximations, not manufactured routes. The first native check exposed flange/trunk intersections; keeping the flange dimensions and narrowing the effective trunk removes overlaps but gives **130.5–131.0% reference packing at the rear flange**. This interface remains failed, alongside PR36's thermal-stress and adverse service screens. The new full downstream-service scope adds 148.151 kg of provisional material; total modeled pixel mass is 193.682 kg. No engineering sign-off, ACTS re-evaluation, magnetic field or event-physics validation is claimed.

Start with [the repeatable workflow](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/detector/preliminary-pixel-detector/tools/pixel_detector_dd4hep/README.md) and [retained results](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/detector/preliminary-pixel-detector/docs/validation/DES-015/results.md). After Spack activation and the existing nodehammer build:

```sh
python3 -B tools/pixel_detector_dd4hep/refresh.py --geant4-init
build/nodehammer/native/nodehammer viewer open build/nodehammer/pixel-detector/full.nhproj
```

Geant4 transport, hit inspection and explicit field/cut settings are the next follow-up. Tracking and the paired session log are updated; exact client-reported tokens were unavailable and were not estimated.

events.text:
The selected DES015 layout controls the text, including the updated barrel and
common two-face endcap support. Earlier alternative studies are not narrated.
Engineering approximations remain briefly visible as properties of the preliminary
layout. The chapter uses source-derived vector figures and explicit source
locators, rather than inventing dimensions or treating generated pictures as data.

Local TDR editing is authorized by the user's direct request. Its README says
“Do not push”; the remote was not updated. A parent-repository source snapshot
and PDF make the content reviewable without moving the gitlink to an unpublished
commit. Human review and any later publication remain distinct actions.

events.text: PubDoc preliminary PixelDetector subsection — see the canonical narrative for outcomes and checks.

User requested a larger text block with less margin; internal nODD decisions
must be explained in the TDR rather than cited; barrel services in Figure 2.1;
use the compact-module SVG from unmerged PR #8 to inform Figure 2.3; cables and
color legend in Figure 2.5; color legend in Figure 2.8.

Text width increased from 124 to 150 mm; side margins 43→30 mm, top 32→25 mm,
bottom 41→28 mm. Body fonts/leading remain readable and unchanged. PubDoc rewrote
the two chapter files to incorporate physical rationale and leave seven public
bibliography entries. Internal decisions, generated inventories and PR revisions
are preserved in source provenance, without publication citations. The rationale
covers module interfaces, guards, populations, support and spreader widths, tube
loads, ring restraint, alternating disc faces/heights, pickups, carrier and cables.
The already-catalogued NIST density table was added to the report's source subset;
the public catalogue and detector design parameters remain unchanged.

Figure 2.1 adds positive-side cable envelopes for all four barrel layers, schematic
cooling paths and extraction detail. Figure 2.5 projects all 82 exact terminal cable
sectors and has a color legend; Figure 2.8 gains a color legend. Figure 2.3 keeps its
quantitative stack and adds the PR #8 common accessible-edge panel showing pads,
wire access, discrete illustrative bumps and coverlay construction. The optional
two-chip/alternative panels are omitted. The adapted SVG and its pinned original
hash are retained. No manufactured bump/loop dimensions are inferred.

User, exact: “PR #39 also needs rebasing”. This bounded task updates
[PR39](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/39), preserving the DES015 preliminary

was requested. Exact client per-turn counters and actual conversation start time

The original remote head was `78bc60bb6da0c9d234baf00d37cadea9dd4964b4` on
`design/pixel-endcap-support`. It merged PR37 into the already merged PR36 branch.
Its tree exactly matched PR37 head `db74bec`; there were no separate merge-resolution
changes. The three unique implementation/evidence commits were replayed onto
main `3db68765f09eb9953afedceaba677ab3744eef7c`, which includes merged PR33.

Work took place on `rebase/pr39-2026-10-05` in a separate worktree. Primary local
main stayed at `ed78a3f`, with unrelated edits to the detector README, palette,

usage records. The original design/endcap and combined-detector local worktrees
were preserved. The request explicitly authorizes rebasing this PR; publication
uses an exact lease against the original remote head.
